text:
maya: Quick sync — we're launching a 3-part Tutorial Bootcamp + tiny reference kit next month. Need to lock email segmentation, landing page variants, benchmark narrative, and webinar tie-in. Who can own which pieces?

sam: I can own the reference kit content + 2 short walkthrough videos. Will need a prod engineer to help with sample configs.

priya: I’ll take the email copy and hero CTAs. Propose two subject lines to A/B test: \u201cShip LLM features faster with our Bootcamp\u201d and \u201cHands-on Bootcamp: Build a prod-ready refkit\u201d. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

ben: I'll handle segmentation and the drip schedule. Target lists: OSS adopters, trial accounts, and existing hosted API users. Recommend 3-touch: announce -> tutorial -> webinar replay.

carlos: Landing page variants: (A) learn-by-doing flow with code-first CTAs, (B) benchmark-driven narrative showcasing latency/cost wins. I can whip up mockups by EOD.

nora: Webinar logistics: I can book the external speaker slot and set up registration. Prefer held the Wednesday before launch so replay lands in drip 2.

maya: Great. Quick asks: 1) Benchmark narrative — prioritize cost-per-token and 99th pct latency vs baseline. Need a one-paragraph summary for the hero. 2) Email seg — ben, can you add triggers for \"trial token > 10k\" and \"repo star > 1\"? 3) Sam, can you provide 3 short CLI examples for the refkit?

sam: Yup on CLI examples. Will add a tiny demo that uses hosted API + local example for Private. Snippets will be <= 3 lines each.

ben: I can do the triggers. Question: include a separate stream for partners/maintainers? Might want tailored outreach.

maya: Yes, add partners stream with early-access CTA and a maintainer checklist.

priya: Draft email snippets: 
- announce subject A: \"Ship LLM features faster with our Bootcamp\"
- announce subject B: \"Hands-on Bootcamp: Build a prod-ready refkit\"
Preview: \"3 short tutorials, code-first samples, + a live workshop — sign up.\"

carlos: Mockups ready by 6pm. Variant B will include a small benchmark strip: \"Up to 3x cheaper per token with batching + cache\" placed under hero.

maya: For the benchmark paragraph: \"We ran the Bootcamp workload across common open models and measured tail latency and unit cost. With workload-aware batching and prefix caching, typical inference cost dropped 40% while 99th percentile latency stayed within SLOs — enabling interactive demos without blowing budget.\" Keep it factual.

sam: I'll generate reproducible commands and a tiny results table for the repo. Will link to the benchmark harness and include a small callout: \"re-run the benchmarks with your model\".

nora: Webinar speaker confirmed. I'll set capacity at 500 and make recording available. Do we want a live QA channel or product demo at the end?

maya: Live QA + 15-minute demo walkthrough. Sam will demo the refkit. Priya, put CTA in final email for webinar signup. Ben, schedule drip so webinar invite goes in touch #2.

ben: Got it. Drip timeline: T0 announce, T+3 days tutorial 1 + webinar invite, T+7 tutorial 2, T+14 webinar reminder + tutorial 3 + replay. I'll set partner/maintainer stream to get private beta opt-in at T0.

priya: I'll write three short preheaders and one longer post-webinar copy for replay nurture.

carlos: Design note: add an animated gif of the refkit quickstart running in terminal for hero var A.

maya: Owners summary: Sam = refkit & demos, Priya = emails & CTAs, Ben = segmentation & drip, Carlos = LP design, Nora = webinar ops. I44d Please post any blockers by EOD.

launch-bot: Reminder set: create GH issue \"bootcamp-launch-playbook\" and assign owners in 4 hours.

sam: One blocker: need a small infra credit for run-on benchmarks. Can someone approve?

maya: Ben, can you approve credits?

ben: Approved up to 200 GPU minutes for benchmark runs. Please log usage.

priya: I'll share draft email flows in #marketing-drafts channel for review by noon tomorrow. :mailbox_with_mail:

carlos: Uploading mocks to Figma now. Link to follow.

maya: Thanks team — let's aim to freeze copy/design by Friday.

sam: On it. Will push CLI snippets and demo repo link when ready.

priya: Will review the benchmark hero copy and tighten messaging for non-technical readers.

ben: Scheduling done — will post calendar invites after Nora shares registration link.

nora: Reg link up: https://events.example.com/bootcamp-live — sharing with comms.

maya: Perfect. Closing thread for now, post updates as comments on the GH issue. :rocket:
